summary.text: Paeonian whom Achilles slew on the banks of Scamander with Thersilochus and a company of his countrymen after Asteropaeus fell — a namesake of Mydon the charioteer of Atymnius whom Antilochus struck down in Book 5.

story.text: When the Paeonians saw Asteropaeus mightily vanquished beneath Achilles' hands, the son of Peleus went on chasing them along the river-banks and slew Mydon with Thersilochus, Astypylus, Mnesus, Thrasius, Aenius, and Ophelestes.
